sources.observation: The west-facing tall chamber tapers down its cantilever. A mural panel rises over the entry stair and the roof shades the curved glazing.
The sloping roof bridges two side wings and opens around the inner courts. The round dining pavilion at the end and the irregular reflecting pond fit their mapped plans.

limitations: The measured map outlines determine the roof plan. The roof slope, stair rise, reflected pool level and small facade details are estimated. Broad color bands stand in for the entrance artwork.
